row-row-row.meter: 6/8, eighth note 0.21 s (95 dotted-quarter beats per minute)
row-row-row.canon: marbles of a round enter 2 bars (2.52 s) apart, so 2 and 4 marbles sing a 2- and 4-part round

hook: the first marble waits at the gate on frame 1, rolls at 0.55 s and plays the first note at 1.8 s
track_srgb: #3E424A (segment gaps), dark parts #32363C, pole #5C626C, glass rim #D6E0EC

camera.note: straight on, the whole spiral and dish in frame

glow.finale_sweep: bottom segment first, 45 ms apart, 0.9 / 0.55 s

music.rule: each segment plays its own pitch when a marble reaches it (a fixed-note instrument), so a canon is a round
music.voice: lead bell, level 0.34 +-5%, panned by the marble's x
music.finale: C chord C3..G5 + 7-note sparkle run when the last marble lands

text.round_titles: 1 MARBLE, 2 MARBLES, 4 MARBLES; each appears when its round's first marble leaves the gate
text.thumbnail: frame 1080 (36.0 s, all 4 marbles of the last round on the track), the upload's thumbnail picture; no text by default (--thumb-title adds the round title)
